<a id="member-6d758069d706ff12"></a>

### Execute(string, params ReadOnlySpan&lt;SpiParameter&gt;)

Executes SQL and returns the rows processed by its final statement.
The call uses an internal subtransaction: success retains changes in the enclosing transaction;
failure rolls back this call's changes before throwing a managed PostgreSQL error.

```csharp
public static long Execute(string commandText, params ReadOnlySpan<SpiParameter> parameters)
```

Parameters:

`commandText` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The SQL commands to execute.

`parameters` — [ReadOnlySpan&lt;SpiParameter&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1)

Typed positional parameters referenced as $1, $2, and so on.

Returns: [long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int64)

The number of rows processed by the final statement.

Exceptions:

- [PgException](/api/ankus.pgexception/): PostgreSQL rejected the command.
- [InvalidOperationException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception): The caller is not on the active PostgreSQL backend thread.

### QuoteIdentifier(string)

Quotes a single SQL identifier using PostgreSQL's keyword rules and quote_all_identifiers setting.

```csharp
public static string QuoteIdentifier(string identifier)
```

Parameters:

`identifier` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

One identifier; dots are part of its name.

Returns: [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The quoting helpers need no transaction, so a background worker can also use them between transactions, for

### Sql(SpiSqlInterpolatedStringHandler)

Creates SQL that binds each interpolated value as a typed positional parameter, keeping values out of its text.
Values must not be quoted or used as identifiers or SQL fragments in the interpolation.

```csharp
public static SpiCommand Sql(SpiSqlInterpolatedStringHandler sql)
```

Parameters:

`sql` — <code>SpiSqlInterpolatedStringHandler</code>

The compiler-built SQL interpolation.

Returns: [SpiCommand](/api/ankus.spicommand/)

Owned SQL and bindings that preserve each value's declared type and lifetime.
